site.name: Vega's Distributors Ltd.
site.conceptBarText: This is an unapproved concept site built from publicly published information. Product details are provisional.

home.title: Wholesale Distribution in Belize
home.description: Vega's Distributors has supplied supermarkets, wholesalers and businesses across Belize since 1980, from three divisions based in Benque Viejo.
home.heroHeadline: Supplying Belize with Trusted Products Since 1980
home.heroLead: Vega's Distributors connects supermarkets, wholesalers and businesses across Belize with established consumer brands, locally manufactured products and dependable distribution support.
home.compositionAlt: A composition of product imagery from brands distributed by Vega's.
home.divisionsLead: Vega's operates a consumer and commercial distribution business, a Belizean bleach manufacturer and a lubricants distributor. Each serves a different customer need from the same Benque Viejo base.
home.categoriesHeading: Find what you stock, by category
home.categoriesLead: Browse the categories Vega's publishes, then request availability from the representative who covers your district.
home.networkLead: Vega's covers Belize through territory representatives. Contact the person responsible for your area directly.
home.whyHeading: Built on published values and practical support

why.title: Integrity, teamwork and respect
why.body: The three values the company publishes, and the basis of how its teams work with customers.

why.title: Longstanding distribution experience
why.body: Trading since 1980 and based in Benque Viejo del Carmen since the year after founding.

why.title: Multiple product categories
why.body: Dry goods, hotel supplies, construction material, lubricants, chocolates, wines and spirits.

why.title: Territory-based customer support
why.body: Named representatives by district, so orders and questions reach the right person.

home.ctaHeading: Need a Product or Sales Representative?
home.ctaLead: Browse the brand directory, contact the representative for your district, or send a structured enquiry and the right team will pick it up.

trust.label: Trading from Benque Viejo del Carmen

home.featuredLead: What Vega's is promoting right now, alongside the categories that move every week.
home.gatewayLead: Vega's works through named territory representatives from the north to the far south. Find the person who covers your district and contact them directly.
home.categoriesEnquiryBody: Listed in the company's published import range, with no product detail online yet. Contact the sales team for availability.
home.pageHeading: Vega's Distributors Ltd., wholesale product distribution in Belize

about.title: About Vega's Distributors
about.description: Founded in 1980 by Eduardo Vega and based in Benque Viejo del Carmen, Vega's imports and distributes products throughout Belize.
about.heading: Service with Pride, since 1980
about.lead: Vega's Distributors Ltd. began as a sole proprietorship importing products from Mexico and Guatemala. Today it is a three-division group supplying supermarkets, wholesalers and commercial customers across Belize.
about.valuesLead: The three values the company publishes.

valueDetail.integrity: Dealing straightforwardly with customers, suppliers and colleagues.
valueDetail.teamwork: Warehouse, sales and administration working to the same standard.
valueDetail.respect: Respect for customers, staff and the communities Vega's serves.

about.sourcingLead: Vega's publishes imports from Central America, Asia and Commonwealth regions, alongside Belizean manufacturing through Vega's Industries.
about.photographyBody: The current public website does not provide authentic photography of the distribution facility, delivery fleet or staff at work. Rather than use stock imagery that would misrepresent the business, those places are held open for approved photography.
about.managementLead: Contacts published on the company website. Confirm they remain current before production use.

divisions.title: Our Divisions
divisions.description: Three divisions: consumer and commercial distribution, Vega's Industries making Blanca Max bleach, and International Lubricants of Belize.
divisions.heading: Our Divisions
divisions.lead: Our company has three divisions: Vega's Distributors, which distributes established consumer brands; Vega's Industries, which manufactures Blanca Max bleach; and International Lubricants of Belize, distributing oils and lubricants.
divisions.industriesDescription: Vega's Industries manufactures Blanca Max bleach in Belize, available in one-litre and half-litre formats.
divisions.lubricantsDescription: ILB distributes heavy-duty motor oils, coolants, greases, hydraulic fluids, gear lubricants and transmission fluids across Belize.
divisions.orderFormatsLead: Customers can order required products in the following formats.

products.title: Products and Brands
products.description: Search the brands and product listings Vega's publishes, by category or division, then request availability from your territory representative.
products.heading: Products and Brands
products.lead: Search the brands Vega's publishes, filter by category, then request availability from the representative covering your district.
products.searchPlaceholder: Search a brand or product name
products.noResultsBody: Try a shorter search term, or clear the filters to see the full directory. If you are looking for something Vega's does not list online, send an enquiry and the sales team can confirm.
products.enquiryOnlyBody: Published in the company's import list, with no product detail online. Contact the sales team for availability.
products.verificationNotice: Every brand, product name and pack size on this site was published on the Vega's website when this concept was built. None has been confirmed as current by the business, so treat listings as provisional and confirm availability before ordering.

brand.provisionalNotice: These listings were published on the Vega's website and have not been confirmed as current. Request availability before ordering.
brand.ctaHeading: Need this brand for your business?
brand.ctaBody: Ask the representative for your district to confirm current availability and pack sizes.

network.title: Sales Network
network.description: Vega's covers Belize through named territory representatives across the north, central, west and south, plus a dedicated ILB contact.
network.heading: National Sales Network
network.lead: Vega's covers Belize through named territory representatives. Find your district below and contact the representative directly.
network.noPhone: No telephone number is published for this territory. Use email, or contact the head office.
network.coverageLead: Territories are grouped by region. Each is served by a named representative.

contact.title: Contact Vega's Distributors
contact.description: Contact Vega's Distributors in Benque Viejo del Carmen for product availability, wholesale accounts, quotes and supplier enquiries.
contact.heading: Contact Vega's
contact.lead: Tell us what you need and the enquiry will reach the right team. For orders and availability, contacting your territory representative directly is usually fastest.
